title: Abusing YouTube Copyright Claims (Tutorial)
summary: The Original Ace shows how creators can use a third-party music distributor to file Content ID claims on their own videos, turning false-claim abuse into a share of ad revenue. It also names distribution companies and their revenue splits.
why: HN cites it as an explanation of the self-claim workaround and an example of how broken YouTube's copyright system is.

quote.text: Could you act as your own copyright troll? Yes!
